subject: Helios Financial: pilot interest update / closing my file

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@heliosfin.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:21:00 -0700
Subject: Helios discovery — notes & next steps

Samira — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery: 

- Current priority: evaluating inference economics for fraud detection features (latency target: < 150ms P99; throughput: ~150 req/s initially)
- Data sensitivity: tokenized transaction metadata; customer asked about VPC/private deployment options and KMS support
- Success criteria: match current latency while reducing per-token cost by ~30% and have a 2-week pilot with sample traffic

Concrete next steps I committed to:
1) Share the discovery notes + a lightweight pilot plan (attached)
2) A pricing sketch for Dedicated vs Hosted with expected unit economics for your workload
3) Intro to our security lead if Helios wants SOC2/KMS details

I've attached the notes from today's call and a starter SOW template so you can share with procurement if helpful. If the above still matches, can you confirm 2 things by end of week?
- Primary decision owner for procurement (email/name)
- Any regulatory constraints that would require an air-gapped/on-prem approach

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a follow-up if you'd prefer.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-sow-template.docx (DOCX)]

Hi Samira — hope you're well. I've tried to follow up a few times with the pilot plan and pricing sketch but haven't heard back. I know priorities shift, so this is a quick housekeeping ask:

If Helios is still evaluating Redwood for this use case, great — reply with a quick "we're interested" and we'll schedule a short sync. If now's not the right timing, reply with "pause" and I'll archive this opportunity and check back in 2–3 months.

If I don't hear anything by EOD Friday, I'll assume you'd like me to close the file for now. No hard feelings — just trying to keep my inbox tidy.

Thanks for your time. If it helps to route directly to procurement or pull in engineering for a deeper technical session, let me know and I'll make introductions.

Best,
